bibl.title: Traces of a notarial signature in BGU III 997 - a deliberate removal?
bibl.note: The signature in B.G.U. III, 997, a copy of an agoranomic sale from Pathyris, was not transcribed in the original edition since only traces of it survive. A closer examination reveals that only the upper layer of the papyrus has been peeled off.
bibl.seg: Marja Vierros, Traces of a notarial signature in BGU III 997 - a deliberate removal?

The signature in B.G.U. III, 997, a copy of an agoranomic sale from Pathyris, was not transcribed in the original edition since only traces of it survive. A closer examination reveals that only the upper layer of the papyrus has been peeled off.
